$schema_note: Authoritative test-count baseline for ACEF. CI fails on regression unless captured_at_commit is bumped via an approved RFC. Test growth (observed > total) is always allowed; shrinkage (observed < total) is denied. F-M1-TIER-INFRA owns this file's schema and the CI gate at scripts/check_baseline_counts.py.
notes: captured_at_commit is set to a sentinel because the actual commit SHA is not knowable at write time. The post-commit step in F-M1-TIER-INFRA is to amend this file with the real SHA, but to stay reproducible for downstream CI the gate only consumes counts.total. The captured_at_commit field is informational provenance.
by_directory totals: 770 unit + 485 conformance + 20 integration = 1275 total (matches counts.total).

by_marker.plumbing = unit (770) + conformance (485) = 1255 because tests/conformance/ and tests/unit/ are auto-tagged 'plumbing' by tests/conftest.py::pytest_collection_modifyitems. tests/integration/ tests are NOT in plumbing tier (they are the separate 'integration' tier; not counted against plumbing's <=60s budget).
by_marker.regression = 112 covers VAL-REGRESSION-* tests (in conformance + a handful of unit tests). regression is a sub-tier of plumbing with a <=20s wall-clock budget.
by_marker.legacy_budget = 2 covers VAL-REGRESSION-LEGACY-BUDGET-001 (the timing self-benchmark and its precondition test).

Growth-allowed: CI gate PASSES when live pytest collection >= total. A test addition that pushes total above 1267 is welcomed and should be reflected in this file when convenient (no RFC required for growth).
Shrinkage-denied: live collection < total => CI gate FAILS. An intentional test removal requires an approved RFC plus a deliberate edit to this file. See VAL-TIER-004.
